about: Sentences a model might write that state something no customer message of the catalogue gives: a person, a sum, a scaled sum, a date, a phone number, a decree, a law and a quotation, in each language. Every person and organisation is invented. tests/test_category_facts_corpus.py requires each to be caught against every example and pool message of every entry (the miss rate at zero); `guard` marks the ones the guard on subject prose must catch too.

uz.text: Bu ishga Xolmirzayev Botirjon Ergashevich rahbarlik qildi.
Yillik foyda 7,3 mlrd so‘mni tashkil etdi.
Batafsil ma’lumot uchun +998 71 555 86 40 raqamiga qo‘ng‘iroq qiling.
Bu masala Vazirlar Mahkamasining 2019-yil 17-iyuldagi 593-son qarori bilan tartibga solingan.
Mehnat kodeksining 214-moddasiga ko‘ra ta’til berilishi shart.
Muallif ta’kidlaganidek, «bilim olish har bir insonning muqaddas burchidir».

ru.text: Работой также руководил Холмирзаев Ботиржон Эргашевич.
Этот вопрос регулируется постановлением Кабинета Министров № 593 от 17 июля 2019 года.
Согласно статье 214 Трудового кодекса отпуск предоставляется обязательно.
Как отмечал автор, «знание есть главная обязанность каждого человека».

en.text: The project was also supervised by Botirjon Xolmirzayev.
The meeting took place on 27 February.
This is governed by Cabinet of Ministers Resolution No. 593 of 17 July 2019.
Under Article 214 of the Labour Code, leave must be granted.
As the author put it, “knowledge is the sacred duty of every person”.
